title: ITVX / Street billboard
slide_intent: Use repeated content panels around one clear service identifier for a multi-title outdoor campaign, because viewers need to recognize the same service across different situations.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen continuity between campaign recognition and service use.
demonstration: A roadside billboard combines vertical talent portraits, yellow inward arrows and the ITVX mark over the centre. The photographed street supplies a real viewing context.
practical_value: Use repeated content panels around one clear service identifier for a multi-title outdoor campaign.

content_islands.name: Street context
content_islands.spec: Traffic and houses surround the wide billboard.

content_islands.name: Brand centre
content_islands.spec: Yellow arrows and ITVX connect the strips.

reference_purposes.Expression: A roadside billboard combines vertical talent portraits, yellow inward arrows and the ITVX mark over the centre. The photographed street supplies a real viewing context.
